[About the Explanations and Glossary]
The content presented in the artwork explanations and glossary is based on one interpretation among several existing theories. 
Therefore, in cases where the information is not necessarily incorrect, we may choose not to revise it. 
We hope for your kind understanding in this matter.

notes.title: Now live! Launched on June 5, 2025 (JST)!
notes.notes:
"Juufuutei Raden™'s Guide for Pixel Museum" is now available!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45333464/957e020c86283ccf13a68a057fe6a634017cdc1d.png[/img]

Since December 6, 2024, we’ve been sharing updates on the development process, and today, it’s finally time for the official release!

With the adorable Curator Raden, charming pixel art, and by learning about the artworks, you're sure to develop a love for art and culture!

We really hope you’ll give it a try!

notes.title: Launching on June 5, 2025! The trailer has also been released!
notes.notes:
"Juufuutei Raden™'s Guide for Pixel Museum" will be available starting at 00:00 on June 5, 2025!
Enjoy plenty of puzzles, fascinating insights into art and culture, and let the adorable Curator Raden bring you comfort♪
Be sure to give it a try!

Both the Steam and Nintendo Switch versions will be available in early summer 2025. Please stay tuned until the release!

Nintendo Switch Version : "Picross™: Juufuutei Raden™'s Guide for Pixel Museum"[/b]
